about: Vane Manor's upper floor, a room file v2 (the format: the builder's README, room files). Metres in the room's frame: x east, y north, z up, the floor's centre on the origin; 22 x 10 m inside (x -11..11, y -5..5), 3.0 m high. The plan is an L: the locked study fills the south-west corner (x -11..-5, y -3..0 and x -11..-6, y -5..-3), built as one wall-piece (G21, decision D5) with its locked door in the notch off the landing. Every prop, spot, portal and night light of packages/content/data/scenes/manor_upper.json is named below. The stairs down to the hall are a visible flight in a well along the south wall (decision D6). The balcony's one-way drop is a closed door in the east wall until G14's balcony door. A key named note, or <key>_note beside <key>, is a comment.

openings.flight_note: G12 (D6: visible stairs): the scene puts the portal on the south wall's tile (12,11), its spawn on (12,10) facing north. The flight cannot leave through the wall, so it goes down in a well along the south wall west of the spawn: tiles (10,10) and (11,10), x -2..0, 1 m wide, its head on the well's east edge beside the spawn; a house flight (0.19 m risers, 0.25 m treads) descends west and runs on 1.0 m under the boards into the dark (the hall's stairs). A balustrade on the three open edges; the portal stays at the foot the scene gives it, (0.5, -5.0), 0.5 m from the well and from the spawn.
